title: A refused API call
description: What every route answers when it does not give a result: the envelope with ok false, no result, and an error. The HTTP status says the kind of answer; error.code says which.

ok.description: Value. Always false for a refusal.

outcome.description: Code. blocked: refused before anything was done (a 4xx). failed: this side's fault (a 5xx).

operation.description: Value. The route's name, or api where no route matched.

result.description: Value. Always null for a refusal.

error.description: Which refusal it is, and the sentence that goes with it.

code.description: Code. unauthorized: 401, the token is not valid here. forbidden: 403, the token's level does not reach the route. not_found: 404, no such cluster, object or job, or outside the token's scope. bad_input: 400. method_not_allowed: 405. rate_limited: 429, too many guesses from the source; Retry-After says when. busy: 429, too many calls at once; Retry-After says when. internal_error: 500. database_unavailable: 503. query_timeout: 503, the query took too long. too_large: 413, the request body is over 1 MB. unavailable: 502, 503 or 504, the manager did not answer or not in time (the last two are given by nginx in front of the manager), or 503 where the block service cannot be asked or the cluster's newest version cannot be read. writes_off: 403, changes are switched off on this installation. cluster_busy: 409, another job runs on the cluster; Retry-After says when to try. idempotency_conflict: 409, the Idempotency-Key was used for another change. blocking_failed: 502, a block was asked for and no node took it. outcome_unknown: 504, the block service was asked and did not answer, so the block may or may not have been placed; read the object's blocks before asking again. certificate_busy: 409, another certificate job is pending or running; Retry-After says when to try. already_exists: 409, a certificate with that name is in the registry. in_use: 409, a draft still names the certificate. cannot_renew: 409, the certificate cannot be renewed by a job now (one is running, the CA still holds a request, or it is renewed with a file). no_change: 409, the certificate is already as asked.

message.description: Text. The sentence that goes with the code.
